svg.text: Smart Campus Lost & Found - ER diagram (Chen notation)
rectangle = entity · diamond = relationship · ellipse = attribute (underlined = key, dashed = derived) · double line = total participation · 1 / N / M = cardinality

STAFF_PROFILE is the staff specialisation of USER (shared key user_id). In the tables, verifier_id and handled_by reference users.user_id; triggers allow only users whose role holds CLAIM_VERIFY / RETURN_RECORD.
